d: Long, flowing bubblegum pink hair with straight-cut bangs and two black antenna-like protrusions emerges from a dark navy blue high-tech bodysuit. The visible right eye is a sharp, glowing magenta with a narrow, intense expression on a youthful, mature face. The slender build is clad in a dark navy and black form-fitting suit with red accents, featuring oversized mechanical sleeves that terminate in long, sharp metallic claws. A white and navy tech-collar masks the lower face, and a large, dark mechanical apparatus is mounted horizontally across the back.
